about: Spacing values Leo settled, each with his words, the reference captures it was measured against (cmux-design-references index ids) and its design spec. Leo (2026-11-02, ask-08a8b942a0): "we'll really want to study how chatgpt desktop and claude desktop do their spacing ... we need to like enforce the good versions when we find them later in the specs/comments/tests or something". scripts/cmux-next/gen-layout-grid.py --check fails when a pinned value leaves its source (a layout-grid metric, or the one match of a pattern in a file) or when that source lost its `settled-spacing: <id>` comment, so moving a settled value also edits this file, in front of the reviewer, with Leo's words beside it. Add a pin whenever Leo settles a spacing.

pins.what: From the newest row's line to the top of the bottom stack (the running tray, else the composer)
pins.words: in the next build, will we have more space between composer and latest messages? i'd like it... tho maybe not as much as claude code / idk why theirs is so big

pins.what: The person's prompt to any row over or under it (centred in its gap)
pins.words: this is too close to tool calls, center it
